name: agent-storyboard
description: Local AI director workbench: shot design, reference assets, static and blocking images, Yovoice voiceover, forced alignment, and animatic preview via MCP.

interface.displayName: Agent 分镜台 · AI 导演工作台
interface.shortDescription: Design shots, bind references, generate images and voiceover, and preview animatics.
interface.longDescription: A local AI director workbench maintained by hengji123, based on Yuuhann1999/agent-storyboard. Manage complete projects through MCP; design shot sizes, actions and camera blocking; bind reference assets with usage constraints; generate versioned static and blocking images; use local or remote Yovoice and VoxCPM voiceover; align the original dialogue locally and review the result in an audio-driven animatic. Project files can live in existing production folders. Image and motion generation use configured agent tools and services.
capabilities: B-roll motion planning and confirmation gate
Shot size, action and camera blocking design
defaultPrompt: 创建完整导演分镜，分别填写景别、台词、静态画面、动作与镜头调度。
核对逐镜参考资产后，生成静态参考图和调度图。
